{{Top|leg}}
'''Repulsor trams'''<ref name="TABS">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref> or '''repulsorlift trams'''<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref> were a type of tram that used [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] technology. The [[Bakur Memorial Building]] on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] had a repulsor tram that helped to move workers and [[Senator/Legends|senators]] around the complex.<ref name="TABS" />
